source.title: iPiano: Inertial Proximal Algorithm for Nonconvex Optimization

problem_form.f: differentiable, possibly nonconvex, with Lipschitz gradient on dom(g)
problem_form.g: convex, possibly nonsmooth, with computable proximal map

algorithm.name: iPiano
algorithm.update: x_{n+1} = (I + alpha_n partial g)^(-1)(x_n - alpha_n grad f(x_n) + beta_n(x_n - x_{n-1}))

convergence.relative_error: exists w_{n+1} in partial F(z_{n+1}) with ||w_{n+1}|| <= (b/2)(Delta_n + Delta_{n+1})
convergence.continuity_condition: exists subsequence z_{n_j} -> z_tilde and F(z_{n_j}) -> F(z_tilde)
convergence.kl_role: Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz property yields finite length and convergence to a critical point

rate_surface.proximal_residual: r(x) = x - (I + partial g)^(-1)(x - grad f(x))

peaice_mapping.beta_scale: geometric scale ratio beta = rho/delta for Logx(beta)*
peaice_mapping.beta_ipiano: inertial memory coefficient in the two-step proximal update
peaice_mapping.typing_rule: beta_ipiano must not be collapsed into beta_scale or beta_close
